// NEGATIVE fixture — default import plus property access behind feature detection.
//
// This check runs against the RAW source, so these comments never spell the banned import out.
import zlib from 'zlib';
import { gzipSync } from 'zlib';

export function unpack(buf) {
  if (typeof zlib.zstdDecompressSync !== 'function') return null;
  return zlib.zstdDecompressSync(buf);
}

export function pack(buf) {
  return gzipSync(buf);
}
